certificateAsPrinted.title: DOCUMENT OF COMPLIANCE
certificateAsPrinted.authority: Government of the Kingdom of Thailand, Marine Department

interpretation: This archived two-page copy records a certificate issued to the legacy Moe Container Line entity in October 2024 with a nominal printed end date of 20 October 2029, subject to periodic verification. Its annual-verification endorsement page is entirely blank. It does not establish current validity, completion of subsequent annual verifications, or certification of the separate Moe Navigation entity.
reuse: A possible supporting source for historical safety-management information after entity and current endorsement checks. Do not publish an unqualified currently valid certification claim from this copy alone.
